actions.action: Check roots for rot (color, texture, smell)
Trim rotted roots back to healthy tissue if found
Scrape brown stems to test if alive
Prune dead stems back to green growth
Move plant to bright open shade for a few days, then to full sun
Repot in terracotta with gritty cactus mix or potting mix plus perlite/pumice, loosening roots
Finger-test soil 2 inches deep and water thoroughly only when dry, emptying saucer
For winter, place in bright south window or under full-spectrum grow light 12-14 hours in cool room

reason: The answer diagnoses overwatering when the confirmed problem was underwatering in fast-drying terracotta. It explicitly says to keep the terracotta, use an even faster-draining gritty mix and skip the plastic, all of which would worsen the drying out and delay the actual fix of switching to a plastic pot and watering more.
